ck: (4)kasitinanacarya astu tarhi tva suparnetyatyakana evatnapete prananan tatra civesvarakyapaksinortve prahnanityatra paraparaprahnataya uktayo tayoreva petavyaptatvitvasravanat tayoranya, anasnananya iti saksatapi tayorpetapitanat pahvi praca purusat sanprasuta iti civananapi nanatvavakanatityasankyaha – tva suparneti tvO suparnavityOkarasyakaratesa nanu petasya nanantarasitataya uktatvat katanakanasya tatanuvatakatvanityato lokasitetyuktan lokavyavaharasitetyarta sa ca vaksyananaprananavirotatapranananeveti pava nanvanuvatanatrena katan petasya nirasa anyata tatyatirupakunavitanaya tatna cuhotityanutyananayakaterapi nirasaprasankatata aha – anuvatasceti nisetayeti prahnani paranartikatvakarena petanisetayetyarta tataca petanuvatasya taniseta eva tatparyana tatrakanasya prananyaniti pava evanatnapetan nirasya petanatrasyaparanartikatvasityartanatnanatnanoranatnanan ca nito petan tusayati – eteneti petanatrasya neha nanastiti nisitatvenetyarta katapatatipeta iti katapatatipiratnanastesan ca nito peta ityarta tarhi katapatO pinavityatipratyaksasya ka katirata aha – pratyaksasyeti sanpavitatosasya pratyaksasya nirtustakanavirote satyaprananyasyEva yuktatvatiti pava ata eva petakrahipratyaksasya prantitvateva tanulaketi tatrsapratyaksasanvatasapeksetyarta anunanatirityatina pOruseyakanaparikraha kevalasyanunanate sankitaprananyakatvenasatakatvat, pratyaksatiprananasanvatenEva prananyan vacyan tasya ca pratyaksateraprananye tatsananavisayanunanatiprananyasya turlapatvatiti pava vyaptikrahakasahacarapratyaksasya pranatvana tanulakanunanati pranananityapi vyacaksate tatra yatyapi vahnivarino sahacarapranepi parvatatO varilinkakavahnyanunanasya prananyanasti tatapi vyaptipaksatarnatavirahe prananyan turavatarananityasaya evanapete patakaprananan nirasya tartyaya trivitanapi satakaprananan tarsayati – apete tviti yatvapete prananapava eva pete prananan pavisyatityata aha – apete tvititi tacintyan tulyanyayena pete prananapava evapete pranananiti vaktun sakyatvat apete prananapavasyanunanavitayEva petasatakataya tanirasavasara eva nirasaniyatvaca nanvatnantarapratiyokikapetasya pratiyokyapratyaksenapratyaksatvasyoktatvat katan tatapavarupapetasya pratyaksatvanityata aha – ekakareneti ekavastutatatnyenetyarta ayan pava petapavo hi pratiyokitatatnyan tatacahanityekakaranupavananekavastuvisayakatve lakavenEkacitatatnyavakahinohaniti pratyaksasya katanapete prananyasanpava iti vinata atnana iti pahuvacananavacetakavacetena satyasiterutesyatvasucanaya anyata sarvatnananE
